analytics.name: Analytic 1793
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; Application State via Android Enterprise / EMM [Managed package inventory/status and package metadata]; Network Connection Creation via Android Enterprise Network Logging / Enterprise VPN [DevicePolicyManager.retrieveNetworkLogs(): DnsEvent / ConnectEvent; VPN flow metadata]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Default 15% interval variance — human-driven traffic varies more. Derive from baseline traffic analysis.
Default 100 bytes stdev — beacon payloads are uniform; human traffic varies.
Per-app known CDN/update domains from 30-day baseline. Derive by measurement.
Default 10 connections — single or few connections are not beacon patterns.
